newsitem.title: UK: Ex-Iraqi minister al-Hiti to head OPEC delegation.
newsitem.headline: Ex-Iraqi minister al-Hiti to head OPEC delegation.

text.p: Former Iraqi oil minister Osama al-Hiti is expected to lead Iraq's delegation to next week's OPEC meeting, OPEC sources said on Friday.
The current Iraqi Oil Minister Amer Mohammed Rasheed will not be attending the talks which begin on Wednesday in Vienna.
OPEC officials did not know why Rasheed would not be attending the meeting which will set OPEC production levels for at least the first half of 1997.
Al-Hiti was Iraqi oil minister from 1992 until 1994. He then served as an adviser to Iraqi President Saddam Hussein but has always maintained links with the Iraqi oil industry, the sources said.

A long delayed deal to allow Iraq to sell $2 billion worth of oil over six months to pay for food and medical supplies has been on hold within the United Nations since late August when the Iraqi government became involved in fighting between Kurdish factions in northern Iraq.
